eventDetail.scope: The College of Information Technology, University of Bahrain is organizing the 2026 International Conference on Innovation and Intelligence for Informatics, Computing, and Technologies (3ICT 2026). The aim of 3ICT 2026 is to provide a forum for the researchers and industry practitioners to exchange the latest fundamental advances in the state of the art and practice of Computing, Advanced Technologies, and Innovative Research. Present their latest research results and perspectives for future work in these areas of research.
